```yaml
requirements:
  - id: S-1
    text: "Generate VGA timing at 1280 x 720 active pixels and 60 Hz using CEA-861 720p60 timing: 74.25 MHz pixel clock, 1650 pixel clocks per line (1280 active, 110 front porch, 40 sync, 220 back porch), 750 lines per frame (720 active, 5 front porch, 5 sync, 20 back porch), with positive horizontal and vertical sync."
    proof: [simulation, hardware, analysis]
    modules: []
  - id: S-2
    text: "With the default pattern selected, display eight vertical colour bars, each 160 active pixels wide, in this order: white, yellow, cyan, green, magenta, red, blue, black."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: []
  - id: S-3
    text: "For each active output pixel, output the median of the nine samples in its 3 x 3 neighbourhood independently for each colour channel."
    proof: [simulation, formal]
    modules: []
  - id: S-4
    text: "Keep the filtered picture and the horizontal and vertical sync signals aligned at the VGA output, with the same active-picture timing as the unfiltered timing generator."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: []
  - id: S-5
    text: "Drive all colour outputs to zero outside the active picture, while BTNC is pressed, or while the pixel clock is not stable."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: []
  - id: S-6
    text: "Illuminate LED[0] when the pixel clock is stable."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: []
  - id: S-7
    text: "Provide a 115200-baud USB-UART interface identified as VMED that allows the host to select a test pattern and read a frame counter."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: []

questions:
  - question: "What boundary rule should the 3 x 3 filter use for neighbourhood samples beyond the active picture?"
    default: "Replicate the nearest active-picture pixel at each boundary, so every active output pixel has a complete 3 x 3 neighbourhood."
    reason: "The specification defines the neighbourhood operation but not how to obtain samples beyond the image edges."
    settles: [S-3]
  - question: "Which patterns should be selectable through the UART?"
    default: "Provide the specified colour bars, a grayscale ramp, and a checkerboard; use the colour bars at startup."
    reason: "The default pattern is specified, but the other choices available through the pattern-selection interface are not."
    settles: [S-2, S-7]
  - question: "What UART command and response format should select a pattern and read the frame counter?"
    default: "Use newline-terminated ASCII commands `P<n>` to select pattern number n and `F` to read the counter, with newline-terminated ASCII replies."
    reason: "The interface functions and baud rate are specified, but the command syntax and response format are not."
    settles: [S-7]
  - question: "How should the frame counter count frames, and what width and reset behavior should it have?"
    default: "Use a 32-bit unsigned counter that increments once per completed displayed frame and starts at zero after power-up or reset."
    reason: "The specification requires a readable frame counter but does not define its counting event, width, or initialization."
    settles: [S-7]
  - question: "What pixel-clock stability criterion should control the colour blanking and LED[0]?"
    default: "Treat the clock as stable when the clock-generation primitive's locked indication is asserted."
    reason: "The specification requires stable-clock behavior but does not define how stability is determined."
    settles: [S-5, S-6]
  - question: "What colour-channel width should be used at the VGA output?"
    default: "Use the Nexys A7 VGA connector's native 4 bits per colour channel."
    reason: "The board is specified, but the required output colour precision is not stated."
    settles: [S-2, S-3]
```

{"answer":"Use the video clock’s locked indication: blank the colours when it is not asserted, and drive LED[0] from it.","quote":"    - while BTNC is pressed or the clock is not locked the colour outputs are 0\n    - LED[0] = video clock locked (1 in simulation with SIM_DIRECT_CLOCK = 1); the other LEDs are 0"}

{"answer":"Use 4 bits per colour channel.","quote":"    - SW[1:0] = 00 -> eight bars of 160 pixels, 4-bit channels, colours FFF FF0 0FF 0F0 F0F F00 00F 000 left to right; black outside the active area"}

```yaml
design:

  name: vmed_video_filter
  board: nexys_a7_100t
  clocks:
    - {name: sys_clk, source: board, port: CLK100MHZ, mhz: 100}
    - {name: pixel_clk, source: mmcm, from: sys_clk, mhz: 74.25}
  resets:
    - {name: sys_reset, domain: sys_clk, polarity: active_low, style: sync, from: CPU_RESETN, via: reset_sync}
    - {name: pixel_reset, domain: pixel_clk, polarity: active_low, style: sync, from: sys_reset, via: reset_sync}
  shell: {design_id: VMED, clock: sys_clk, reset: sys_reset}
  modules:
    - name: pattern_timing
      kind: rtl
      clocks: {pixel_clk: pixel_clk}
      resets: {pixel_reset: pixel_reset}
      window_base: 0x00
      register_crossings: {PATTERN: xpm_cdc_handshake, FRAME_COUNT: xpm_cdc_handshake}
    - name: median_filter
      kind: rtl
      clocks: {pixel_clk: pixel_clk}
      resets: {pixel_reset: pixel_reset}

contracts:
  pattern_timing:
    schema: fpga-design-agent/contract/v1
    module: pattern_timing
    summary: "Generates the video raster and test pattern; exposes pattern selection and frame count through the top-level register window."
    clocks:
      - {name: pixel_clk, port: clk, max_mhz: 74.25}
    resets:
      - {name: pixel_reset, port: rst, clock: pixel_clk, polarity: active_low, style: sync}
    ports:
      - {name: clk, dir: in}
      - {name: rst, dir: in}
      - {name: pattern_select, dir: in, width: 2, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: frame_count, dir: out, width: 32, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: m_axis_tvalid, dir: out, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: m_axis_tready, dir: in, clock: pixel_clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tdata, dir: out, width: 36, clock: pixel_clk}
    data_formats:
      - {name: raster_x, format: u11, packing: "Raster horizontal coordinate"}
      - {name: raster_y, format: u10, packing: "Raster vertical coordinate"}
      - {name: channel, format: u4, packing: "Unsigned VGA colour channel"}
      - {name: flag, format: u1, packing: "Boolean raster or sync flag"}
    interfaces:
      - name: out
        protocol: axi4-stream
        role: master
        prefix: m_axis
        clock: pixel_clk
        reset: pixel_reset
        tdata:
          width: 36
          fields:
            - {name: x, bits: [35, 25], format: raster_x}
            - {name: y, bits: [24, 15], format: raster_y}
            - {name: red, bits: [14, 11], format: channel}
            - {name: green, bits: [10, 7], format: channel}
            - {name: blue, bits: [6, 3], format: channel}
            - {name: active, bits: [2, 2], format: flag}
            - {name: hsync, bits: [1, 1], format: flag}
            - {name: vsync, bits: [0, 0], format: flag}
        backpressure: false
        source_gaps: false
    registers:
      bus: top
      map:
        - name: PATTERN
          offset: 0x00
          access: RW
          reset: 0
          width: 2
          volatile: false
          fields:
            - {name: pattern_select, bits: [1, 0], port: pattern_select}
        - name: FRAME_COUNT
          offset: 0x04
          access: RO
          reset: 0
          width: 32
          volatile: true
          fields:
            - {name: frame_count, bits: [31, 0], port: frame_count}
    throughput:
      - {interface: out, beats_per_cycle: 1}

  median_filter:
    schema: fpga-design-agent/contract/v1
    module: median_filter
    summary: "Computes the per-channel 3 x 3 median for active pixels and preserves aligned raster metadata."
    clocks:
      - {name: pixel_clk, port: clk, max_mhz: 74.25}
    resets:
      - {name: pixel_reset, port: rst, clock: pixel_clk, polarity: active_low, style: sync}
    ports:
      - {name: clk, dir: in}
      - {name: rst, dir: in}
      - {name: s_axis_tvalid, dir: in, clock: pixel_clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tready, dir: out, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: s_axis_tdata, dir: in, width: 36, clock: pixel_clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tvalid, dir: out, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: m_axis_tready, dir: in, clock: pixel_clk}
      - {name: m_axis_tdata, dir: out, width: 36, clock: pixel_clk}
    data_formats:
      - {name: raster_x, format: u11, packing: "Raster horizontal coordinate"}
      - {name: raster_y, format: u10, packing: "Raster vertical coordinate"}
      - {name: channel, format: u4, packing: "Unsigned VGA colour channel"}
      - {name: flag, format: u1, packing: "Boolean raster or sync flag"}
    interfaces:
      - name: in
        protocol: axi4-stream
        role: slave
        prefix: s_axis
        clock: pixel_clk
        reset: pixel_reset
        tdata:
          width: 36
          fields:
            - {name: x, bits: [35, 25], format: raster_x}
            - {name: y, bits: [24, 15], format: raster_y}
            - {name: red, bits: [14, 11], format: channel}
            - {name: green, bits: [10, 7], format: channel}
            - {name: blue, bits: [6, 3], format: channel}
            - {name: active, bits: [2, 2], format: flag}
            - {name: hsync, bits: [1, 1], format: flag}
            - {name: vsync, bits: [0, 0], format: flag}
        backpressure: false
        source_gaps: false
      - name: out
        protocol: axi4-stream
        role: master
        prefix: m_axis
        clock: pixel_clk
        reset: pixel_reset
        tdata:
          width: 36
          fields:
            - {name: x, bits: [35, 25], format: raster_x}
            - {name: y, bits: [24, 15], format: raster_y}
            - {name: red, bits: [14, 11], format: channel}
            - {name: green, bits: [10, 7], format: channel}
            - {name: blue, bits: [6, 3], format: channel}
            - {name: active, bits: [2, 2], format: flag}
            - {name: hsync, bits: [1, 1], format: flag}
            - {name: vsync, bits: [0, 0], format: flag}
        backpressure: false
        source_gaps: false
    throughput:
      - {interface: in, beats_per_cycle: 1}
      - {interface: out, beats_per_cycle: 1}

  vga_output:
    schema: fpga-design-agent/contract/v1
    module: vga_output
    summary: "Drives the VGA colour and sync outputs from the filtered raster and blanks colour when required."
    clocks:
      - {name: pixel_clk, port: clk, max_mhz: 74.25}
    resets:
      - {name: pixel_reset, port: rst, clock: pixel_clk, polarity: active_low, style: sync}
    ports:
      - {name: clk, dir: in}
      - {name: rst, dir: in}
      - {name: pixel_stable, dir: in, width: 1, clock: async}
      - {name: blank_button, dir: in, width: 1, clock: async}
      - {name: s_axis_tvalid, dir: in, clock: pixel_clk}
      - {name: s_axis_tready, dir: out, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: s_axis_tdata, dir: in, width: 36, clock: pixel_clk}
      - {name: red, dir: out, width: 4, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: green, dir: out, width: 4, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: blue, dir: out, width: 4, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: hsync, dir: out, width: 1, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
      - {name: vsync, dir: out, width: 1, clock: pixel_clk, reset_value: 0}
    data_formats:
      - {name: raster_x, format: u11, packing: "Raster horizontal coordinate"}
      - {name: raster_y, format: u10, packing: "Raster vertical coordinate"}
      - {name: channel, format: u4, packing: "Unsigned VGA colour channel"}
      - {name: flag, format: u1, packing: "Boolean raster or sync flag"}
    interfaces:
      - name: in
        protocol: axi4-stream
        role: slave
        prefix: s_axis
        clock: pixel_clk
        reset: pixel_reset
        tdata:
          width: 36
          fields:
            - {name: x, bits: [35, 25], format: raster_x}
            - {name: y, bits: [24, 15], format: raster_y}
            - {name: red, bits: [14, 11], format: channel}
            - {name: green, bits: [10, 7], format: channel}
            - {name: blue, bits: [6, 3], format: channel}
            - {name: active, bits: [2, 2], format: flag}
            - {name: hsync, bits: [1, 1], format: flag}
            - {name: vsync, bits: [0, 0], format: flag}
        backpressure: false
        source_gaps: false
    throughput:
      - {interface: in, beats_per_cycle: 1}

module_specs:
  fpga_shell: |
    The always-present shell owns the USB-UART and register window at 0x80-0xFF.
    It uses design ID VMED and 115200 baud. It accepts newline-terminated ASCII
    P<n> commands to select a test pattern and F commands to read the frame
    counter, and returns newline-terminated ASCII replies. The FPGA UART receive
    input is UART_TXD_IN; the FPGA UART transmit output is UART_RXD_OUT. The
    pattern_timing top-level register map is placed at window_base 0x00.
  pattern_timing: |
    Generates CEA-861 720p60 timing: 1650 pixel clocks per line and 750 lines
    per frame, with 1280 by 720 active pixels, the specified porches and sync
    intervals, and positive sync. Generates eight 160-pixel vertical colour
    bars by default, and also provides a grayscale ramp and checkerboard.
    Pattern values are 0=colour bars, 1=grayscale ramp, and 2=checkerboard.
    Increments a 32-bit unsigned frame counter once per completed displayed
    frame and resets it to zero.
  median_filter: |
    For each active output pixel, computes the median of the nine samples in
    the corresponding 3 x 3 neighbourhood independently for red, green, and
    blue. Replicates the nearest active-picture pixel at boundaries. Delays
    raster metadata so filtered pixels, active timing, and sync remain aligned.
    Sustains one raster beat per pixel clock without inserting gaps.
  vga_output: |
    Drives four-bit red, green, and blue VGA channels and the aligned horizontal
    and vertical sync. Drives all colour channels to zero outside active video,
    while BTNC is pressed, and while pixel clock stability is not asserted.
    The top-level connects the pixel-clock lock indication to pixel_stable.

requirements:

    text: "Generate VGA timing at 1280 x 720 active pixels and 60 Hz using CEA-861 720p60 timing: 74.25 MHz pixel clock, 1650 pixel clocks per line (1280 active, 110 front porch, 40 sync, 220 back porch), 750 lines per frame (720 active, 5 front porch, 5 sync, 20 back porch), with positive horizontal and vertical sync."
    proof: [simulation, hardware, analysis]
    modules: [pattern_timing, top]
  - id: S-2
    text: "With the default pattern selected, display eight vertical colour bars, each 160 active pixels wide, in this order: white, yellow, cyan, green, magenta, red, blue, black."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: [pattern_timing, top]
  - id: S-3
    text: "For each active output pixel, output the median of the nine samples in its 3 x 3 neighbourhood independently for each colour channel."
    proof: [simulation, formal]
    modules: [median_filter]
  - id: S-4
    text: "Keep the filtered picture and the horizontal and vertical sync signals aligned at the VGA output, with the same active-picture timing as the unfiltered timing generator."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: [median_filter, vga_output, top]
  - id: S-5
    text: "Drive all colour outputs to zero outside the active picture, while BTNC is pressed, or while the pixel clock is not stable."
```

```yaml
module_specs:
  fpga_shell: |
    The always-present shell owns the USB-UART and register window at 0x80-0xFF.
    It uses design ID VMED and 115200 baud. It accepts newline-terminated ASCII
    P<n> commands to select a test pattern and F commands to read the frame
    counter, and returns newline-terminated ASCII replies. The FPGA UART receive
    input is UART_TXD_IN; the FPGA UART transmit output is UART_RXD_OUT. The
    pattern_timing top-level register map is placed at window_base 0x00.
  pattern_timing: |
    Generates CEA-861 720p60 timing: 1650 pixel clocks per line and 750 lines
    per frame, with 1280 by 720 active pixels, the specified porches and sync
    intervals, and positive sync. Generates eight 160-pixel vertical colour
    bars by default, and also provides a grayscale ramp and checkerboard.
    Pattern values are 0=colour bars, 1=grayscale ramp, and 2=checkerboard.
    Increments a 32-bit unsigned frame counter once per completed displayed
    frame and resets it to zero.
  median_filter: |
    For each active output pixel, computes the median of the nine samples in
    the corresponding 3 x 3 neighbourhood independently for red, green, and
    blue. Replicates the nearest active-picture pixel at boundaries. Delays
    raster metadata so filtered pixels, active timing, and sync remain aligned.
    Sustains one raster beat per pixel clock without inserting gaps.
  vga_output: |
    Drives four-bit red, green, and blue VGA channels and the aligned horizontal
    and vertical sync. Drives all colour channels to zero outside active video,
    while BTNC is pressed, and while pixel clock stability is not asserted.
    The top-level connects the pixel-clock lock indication to pixel_stable.

requirements:
  - id: S-1
    text: "Generate VGA timing at 1280 x 720 active pixels and 60 Hz using CEA-861 720p60 timing: 74.25 MHz pixel clock, 1650 pixel clocks per line (1280 active, 110 front porch, 40 sync, 220 back porch), 750 lines per frame (720 active, 5 front porch, 5 sync, 20 back porch), with positive horizontal and vertical sync."
    proof: [simulation, hardware, analysis]
    modules: [pattern_timing, top]
  - id: S-2
    text: "With the default pattern selected, display eight vertical colour bars, each 160 active pixels wide, in this order: white, yellow, cyan, green, magenta, red, blue, black."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: [pattern_timing, top]
  - id: S-3
    text: "For each active output pixel, output the median of the nine samples in its 3 x 3 neighbourhood independently for each colour channel."
    proof: [simulation, formal]
    modules: [median_filter]
  - id: S-4
    text: "Keep the filtered picture and the horizontal and vertical sync signals aligned at the VGA output, with the same active-picture timing as the unfiltered timing generator."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: [median_filter, vga_output, top]
  - id: S-5
    text: "Drive all colour outputs to zero outside the active picture, while BTNC is pressed, or while the pixel clock is not stable."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: [vga_output, top]
  - id: S-6
    text: "Illuminate LED[0] when the pixel clock is stable."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: [top]
  - id: S-7
    text: "Provide a 115200-baud USB-UART interface identified as VMED that allows the host to select a test pattern and read a frame counter."
    proof: [simulation, hardware]
    modules: [top, pattern_timing]
```
